content: To get crop recommendations, go to the Home/Map page and either drop a pin on your farm plot or tap 'Analyse My Farm Plot' to use your device GPS. AgroPredict AI concurrently retrieves soil properties (pH, clay, sand, silt, depth), 7-day live weather, elevation, and waterway proximity. On the Dashboard, you receive your top 5 ranked crops, complete with composite suitability scores, soil compatibility %, weather match %, expected yield/acre, estimated revenue, cost, and net profit per acre. The highest net profit crop is highlighted with a '⭐ Highest expected net profit' badge.

topic: How to Check Groundwater and Borewell Safety
content: Groundwater safety is displayed directly as a static, non-clickable widget on your Farm Intelligence Dashboard. It shows an Aquifer Safety Score from 0 to 100 and a friendly status badge: 'Good' (safe aquifer conditions), 'Moderate' (survey suggested), or 'Risk' (high failure risk). You can expand the widget in-place on the Dashboard to see the 4 contributing factors: soil depth, elevation, annual rainfall, and distance to nearest river, along with estimated drilling failure cost.

topic: How to Diagnose a Plant Disease from a Photo
content: To diagnose plant health issues using a photo, open the AI Advisory / Chat page and tap the prominent Camera button or switch to the 'Photo Scan' tab. Upload or capture a clear photo of the affected plant or leaf. For maximum accuracy: photograph a single affected leaf in daylight against a neutral background, avoiding shadows and blur. Optionally provide the crop name as a hint. AgroPredict AI analyzes the photo and returns the disease/pest name, confidence score, root cause, organic remedies (e.g. Neem oil, Trichoderma), chemical options with precise dosages, and future prevention methods. Tap the '🔊 Listen' button to hear the diagnosis read aloud.

topic: How to Use Voice Input and Audio Speech
content: HarvestIQ provides voice accessibility for low-literacy and regional-language farmers. Tap the microphone icon (🎤) next to the chat input to speak your agricultural question in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), or Tamil (தமிழ்). The app transcribes your speech into text. On any AI chat response, top crop recommendation, or groundwater status, tap the '🔊 Listen' button to hear the answer read aloud in your selected language using browser speech synthesis.

topic: How to Check Mandi Market Prices
content: Open the Mandi Market page and select your crop from the dropdown. You will see current wholesale APMC prices (min, max, modal in ₹/quintal), the best mandi to sell at for maximum profit, nearby market comparison tables, and a 30-day price trend chart (Rising, Falling, or Stable) to help decide the best time to sell.

topic: How to Check Weather and Smart Irrigation
content: Open the Weather page after selecting your farm plot. It displays current temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, 7-day forecast, 6cm soil temperature, evapotranspiration rates, and an automated irrigation advisory calculating exact water requirements in litres/acre/day.

topic: How to Improve Accuracy with Soil Test Data
content: By default, AgroPredict estimates soil characteristics using regional government averages (60-75% confidence). You can upgrade accuracy anytime using the Soil Data Source selector on the Dashboard: choose 'Soil Lab Test Upload' to upload a photo/PDF of your lab report (OCR extracts N, P, K, pH with 100% confidence), or 'Manual Entry' to type in your own N, P, K, and pH values (90% confidence). Recommendations will instantly recompute with high confidence.

Tap the Language toggle in the top navigation bar at any time to switch the interface instantly between English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Tamil (தமிழ்). All labels, AI chat answers, and voice outputs follow your selected language.

topic: How to Save Plots and Submit Post-Harvest Feedback
content: After analysing a farm plot, save it under the History page with a custom name and notes. After harvest, you can reopen the saved plot and submit your actual crop yield and actual profit. This data is recorded alongside the soil tier confidence to continuously refine and retrain the predictive yield models.

topic: What AgroPredict HarvestIQ Does - App Overview
content: HarvestIQ (AgroPredict AI) is a precision agriculture and geospatial intelligence platform for Indian farmers. From a single map pin-drop, it delivers AI crop recommendations, profit forecasting, inline groundwater safety scores, live weather and irrigation guides, mandi price intelligence, plant disease photo diagnosis, and 24/7 multilingual conversational advisory with full voice support.
